english.title: Attempt to enter / remain on Croydon Tramlink property when intoxicated / under influence of drugs
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) attempted to enter or remain on Croydon Tramlink Property, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TRAM / PLACE OR AREA..), while

english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 5(1), 30 and 26 of the Croydon Tramlink Byelaws made under section 46 of the Croydon Tramlink Act 1994.
